about: A self-hosted app for families to track food, exercise, water and health together.

prs.title: Whole stones and feet no longer come back one short
prs.broken: With weight in stones and pounds, 13 st showed as 12 st 14 lb, and typing in the pound box added to the 14. Height had the same problem: 6 ft showed as 5 ft 12 in.
prs.changed: The conversion back from kilograms and centimetres now rounds to the shown precision before splitting into stones and pounds, or feet and inches.
prs.matters: People who track in stones or feet see the number they typed, and the boxes behave as expected.
